messages:
alex.w: Heads-up — starting our 23:00 UTC change window in ~10m. Primary goal: cross-service rollout for API (4.1 -> 4.2), Console schema migration M-7, Runtime bump to 3.2, Router tweak to 2.9. Plan: canary API -> console migration -> runtime rollout -> router soft-pin + drain. Need quick yes/no on pins + rollback criteria.
Sam: +1. What are the rollback triggers for runtime?
alex.w: Thinking automatic rollback if error-rate for runtime-backed routes > 5% sustained for 5m OR latency p50 regresses > 200ms. Open to tweaks.
Maria: Console migration M-7 needs a brief read-lock. It'll block writes to /admin for ~90s. Need us to pin router for the migration window so traffic hits healthy console replicas.
JD: Agree on pin. Recommend pin router to 2.9.1 for 12h to avoid auto-updates during migration. Also suggest runtime pin fallback to 3.1.9 if canary fails.
deploy-bot: preflight checks started for release 2025-06-crosssvc-1
deploy-bot: preflight results: api: ok, console: ok (schema compatible), runtime: ok, router: warning - pool utilization 72% in eu-west-1, possible eviction risk during burst.
oncall-bot: FYI quota bump request for router pool submitted (REQ-4521). Approver: ops-team.
Sam: Pool at 72% — can we throttle canary or reduce canary pct from 5% -> 2% to be safe?
alex.w: let's drop API canary to 2% and stagger start times by 2m between services. Good catch.
Nina: I'll double-check ops-runbook for router eviction. If we still see >80% we'll abort.
JD: CLI pin commands (for record):
```
# pin router to stable during migration
deployctl pin --service router --version 2.9.1 --duration 12h --reason "Console M-7 migration"
# smaller canary for api
deployctl rollout --service api --version 4.2 --strategy canary --percent 2 --stagger 2m
```
Sam: Also add an automatic fallback for runtime in our rollout config: if errors > 5% OR p50 +200ms for 5m, rollback to 3.1.9.
alex.w: Agreed. Who wants to own release notes update? Need short blurb for customer-facing notes about schema migration window and minor router pin.
Maria: I'll update release notes and include the admin write-lock warning. Will push a PR to docs in 5m.
deploy-bot: canary started for api@4.2 (2%) — id: cb-1772
deploy-bot: monitor: api errors 0.0% | p50 +10ms | no alarms.
Nina: ops-runbook check done: router drainage hook verified. Eviction mitigation: reduce new connection rate if pool >75%.
alex.w: Decision summary: 1) API -> canary 2% staggered; 2) Console migration with 90s write-lock; 3) Runtime rollout to 3.2 with fast-fail rollback to 3.1.9 if thresholds hit; 4) Router pinned to 2.9.1 for 12h; 5) Stagger all starts by 2m.
Sam: +1
JD: +1
Maria: PR for release-notes: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4982 (includes admin note + rollback criteria)
alex.w: I'll run the pin now.
deploy-bot: pin created: router@2.9.1 until +12h (action id: pin-8843) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: next: console migration scheduled in 8m. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/console-m7
alex.w: thanks everyone. If anything spikes, abort and call rollback. I'll post final status in 15m. :thumbsup:
